protocol.scope: Same OLD3 FFHQ x4tasks x sigma.05/.10. Single intervention at A92 index15 only. A92 prefix/initial true gradient reused; native14-point continuation. No new image/seed/grid/frequency or window expansion.
protocol.objective: gamma=all db4/level3 coefficients, Delta=W^T[(Wq)*gamma]. Min .5*||observed(y-H(clamped rawD_s(z+Delta)))||^2/sigma_y^2 + .5*precision*sum(gamma^2). Real next network response, not target-gradient matching, g_j/q_j division, diagonal Gram approximation or independent coefficient solve.
protocol.arms: SIGNED_JOINT precision1; SCALAR_TIED constrains all gains identical under the SAME full-field objective/prior; NONNEG_JOINT precision1; SIGNED_DATA_ONLY precision0. precision1 means gamma~N(0,1) working prior, an explicit model choice, not parameter-free/calibrated posterior. Tied scalar isolates coefficient freedom, nonnegative isolates signs, zero-prior isolates regularization.
protocol.solver: All coefficients updated jointly by inputVJP through H/next denoiser and exact DWT chain. gamma starts0, not1/scalar reference. Two accepted proximal-gradient updates; at most6 one-sided actual-objective backtracks/update. First eta=1/max(1,maxabs(data gradient)); halve on failed majorization, reuse accepted eta. No GT tuning, no0..2 cap, no native/scalar correction norm budget.
protocol.stability: Backtracking requires smooth-data majorization and nonincrease of complete objective within64 float32 eps relative scalar tolerance. The sigma likelihood is Gaussian fidelity, NOT subtraction of noise energy/SURE/full-image unbiased risk. Fixed2 accepted updates means budget-limited diagnostic, not optimal/converged.
protocol.failure: No accepted step within budget => unresolved with attempted costs and solver trace, no fallback image. Nonfinite/RNG/source/count mismatch => failed stop, no automatic retry. Exact zero proximal move => stationary at working precision, explicitly reported.
protocol.accounting: At most12 trialF+1 extra gradientF/VJP+14 continuationF=27F/1VJP per arm. 96arms =>2592F/96VJP max, warmup1F/1VJP per load separate. The first current gradient is SHA-bound A92 and not a new call. Internal checkpoint recompute included in walltime, not additional top-level denoiser calls.
protocol.measurement: Original model[-1,1] sigma and original H. Mask stats/likelihood observedRGB only. Other given-y, kernels and original q mapping unchanged; no pretrained model updates or new zeta/D learning.
protocol.pairing: Same initial uncond/current innovation and A92 future CPU/CUDA RNG. Solver never draws randomness. Continuation grid exactly original14 calls; solver calls all at next_t309. Bounds/hash/real Torch checkpoint gates mandatory. No large tensor downloads/Mac GPU claims.
protocol.decisions: Per task/noise signed joint must compare to native, A92 grouped diagonal and A92 physical direct at same intervention. Positive: meanPSNR>=+.1dB,>=2/3 wins,SSIM nondecrease,LPIPS nonincrease. Report objective reduction/negative fraction/gain tails/actual correction length/noise-fitting decomposition and final regional risks. No arm chosen by GT.
protocol.historical: A71 scalar summary read from bound completed summary (fixes missing per-run metrics issue); comparison means descriptive only, not same control scope or matched full runtime.
protocol.timing: Solver+14F suffix includes cached state/y/entry loads/operator construction/outputCPU sync; solver time separated inside. Metrics/noise-decomposition/image writes/model loading/warmup separately. Not complete300 reconstruction timing or acceleration.
protocol.limits: Original3 reused development images, one seed. A high-dimensional signed diagonal can represent almost arbitrary vectors, so success does not itself establish novelty or calibrated risk. New nonlinear objective and prior require this experiment; no guarantee all tasks positive.
